Adding the technical appendix for clarity. Quick notes on the latency comparison methodology (see attached xlsx):

- We will run 3 run types: single-stream cold-start, sustained 5qps steady-state, and burst (10s spike). Each run will collect p50/p95/p99 and tail latency for token generation and first-byte.
- For fair comparison with Vertex and SageMaker: match model family (open models), sequence length, and batching windows. We'll run both FP16 and int8 quantized variants where supported and report delta to baseline FP16.
- KV-cache effect: tests include repeated-prefix cases to measure cache hit improvements (expected 2–4x token throughput improvement for repeated context).
- Measurement scripts: curl + tokenized payload, plus server-side timing hooks; we'll provide the scripts in the Drive link.

Also flagged in the sheet: one test that often surfaces hallucination regressions is a prompt where the model must cite a short passage from a supplied context; we'll include negative examples where model invents facts.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi — attaching the initial hallucination prompt set (hallucination_prompts_v1.txt) and quick scoring rubric. Summary of the approach:

- Prompt coverage: 75 prompts across 6 intent buckets (fact-recall, instruction execution, summarization with hallucination traps, multi-hop reasoning, numeric extraction, and attribution).
- Expected outputs: For each prompt we include an example correct answer and 3 failure modes (hallucinated entity / invented date / unsupported causal claim).
- Scoring: automated string-match + semantic similarity threshold for partial credit. We'll also surface a per-prompt confidence delta between Redwood model and the hyperscaler baseline to prioritize regression fixes.
- Acceptance criteria: no more than 3 critical hallucination failures per 75 prompts on p95 runs (this is configurable).

Proposed pilot run: Acme runs the prompts against the three chosen models (we recommended: Redwood-Open-8k, LlamaX-70B-int8, and a hyperscaler gp-large instance). We'll collate outputs and run the scoring script; Marissa will host a 45-minute readout to walk failures the week of Aug 10 if that works.

Attachments referenced: hallucination_prompts_v1.txt, scoring_runner.py (stub referenced in Drive link).
